hook: Climate talks just failed. First since 2009
reel_hook: Climate talks collapsed. First time since 2009

slides.title: COP31 ends with no deal
slides.image_prompt: An empty negotiating table with a small globe and an unsigned document under a single lamp, oil barrels stacked in the dim background
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
COP31 in Turkey ended Sunday without any final agreement.
WHY IT MATTERS
First failed UN climate deal since Copenhagen in 2009.
FOR YOU
Paris Agreement and past pledges still stand; no new fossil fuel plan.
slides.body: COP31 in Turkey ended Sunday without any final agreement. First failed UN climate deal since Copenhagen in 2009. Paris Agreement and past pledges still stand; no new fossil fuel plan.

slides.title: NATO meets over Poland missiles
slides.image_prompt: A military radar dish on a frosty field at dusk, a twisted piece of missile debris lying in the grass under cold blue light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
NATO's top body meets Monday over Russian missiles in Poland.
WHY IT MATTERS
Rutte pledged in Warsaw to defend Polish territory.
FOR YOU
Poland asked for more F-35s and early-warning jets; nothing announced yet.
slides.body: NATO's top body meets Monday over Russian missiles in Poland. Rutte pledged in Warsaw to defend Polish territory. Poland asked for more F-35s and early-warning jets; nothing announced yet.
slides.credit: Major Ofer, Israeli Air Force רס"ן עופר, חיל האוויר הישראלי (CC BY 4.0) via wikimedia

slides.title: Iran strikes Bahrain site
slides.image_prompt: Smoke rising from an industrial plant on a desert coastline at night, an air-defence radar silhouetted in the foreground
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
An Iranian attack hit an industrial site in Bahrain's Sitra.
WHY IT MATTERS
Bahrain hosts the US Navy's Fifth Fleet.
FOR YOU
Talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remain stalled, with Qatar mediating.
slides.body: An Iranian attack hit an industrial site in Bahrain's Sitra. Bahrain hosts the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. Talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remain stalled, with Qatar mediating.

slides.title: 11 dead in cartel boss arrest
slides.image_prompt: A military helicopter on a dusty airstrip at dawn, a pair of open handcuffs resting on a wooden crate in the foreground
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
At least 11 died in El Chapo Isidro's arrest and aftermath.
WHY IT MATTERS
US charged him in 2012 over fentanyl, cocaine, heroin.
FOR YOU
A second alleged leader, El Serafin, was also arrested; the US helped.
slides.body: At least 11 died in El Chapo Isidro's arrest and aftermath. US charged him in 2012 over fentanyl, cocaine, heroin. A second alleged leader, El Serafin, was also arrested; the US helped.

slides.title: Probe reaches Mercury orbit
slides.image_prompt: A small spacecraft with solar panels glinting beside a grey cratered planet, the huge blazing Sun behind it against black space
slides.label: SCIENCE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
BepiColombo entered orbit around Mercury after an eight-year trip.
WHY IT MATTERS
Only the second mission ever to orbit Mercury.
FOR YOU
Two orbiters will study Mercury's interior, magnetism and surface for at least a year.
slides.body: BepiColombo entered orbit around Mercury after an eight-year trip. Only the second mission ever to orbit Mercury. Two orbiters will study Mercury's interior, magnetism and surface for at least a year.
slides.credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Arizona State Universit (Public domain) via wikimedia

🛡️ NATO's top body meets Monday after Russian missiles landed in Poland.
🔥 Iranian attack hit an industrial site in Bahrain; two people hurt. Hormuz talks still stalled.
🚔 At least 11 dead around the arrest of cartel boss El Chapo Isidro in Mexico.
🪐 BepiColombo is now orbiting Mercury after an eight-year trip.
